The thing a group chat cannot do: an action, a preview, a risk class, who may answer, and an audit record.

**Direction:** Harness → Chips  
**Sent by:** a harness  
**Requires a run:** yes  
**Schema:** [`approval.request.json`](/schema/approval.request.json)

## Fields

Every event also carries the [envelope](/reference/envelope/).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | yes | `1` | Protocol major version. |
| `type` | yes | `"approval.request"` |  |
| `id` | yes | `string` | The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event. |
| `ts` | yes | `string` | When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced. |
| `workspace_id` | yes | `string` | A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID. |
| `space_id` | no | `string` | The space, when the event belongs to one. |
| `run_id` | no | `string` | The run, when the event belongs to one. |
| `seq` | no | `number` | Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in. |
| `idempotency_key` | no | `string` | Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op. |
| `actor` | yes | object | The participant an event is attributed to. |
| `actor.kind` | yes | `"person" \| "harness" \| "agent" \| "system"` | Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted. |
| `actor.id` | yes | `string` | The participant id, or `system` for Chips. |
| `actor.harness_id` | no | `string` | For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips. |
| `approval_id` | yes | `string` | Minted by the harness, so a retry after a reconnect is the same ask. |
| `step_id` | no | `string` | The plan step this ask belongs to. |
| `action` | yes | object | An action a harness proposes to take. |
| `action.kind` | yes | `string` | A dotted verb, for example `email.send` or `payment.transfer`. Policy rules glob on it. |
| `action.input` | no | `unknown` | The arguments, shaped by the tool being called. |
| `action.external` | no | `boolean` | True when the action leaves the workspace. |
| `action.irreversible` | no | `boolean` | True when the action cannot be undone. |
| `action.money_usd` | no | `number` | Amount at stake, in US dollars. |
| `question` | no | `string` | The question the person answers yes or no, as one sentence in plain words: `Turn off the Robinhood connector?`. The card leads with it. Without it the card is headed by the preview's title, else the action's kind (ADR 0142). |
| `effect` | no | `string` | What a yes does, in a sentence or two: `Its 73 tools disappear from every Space.` Drawn under the question. |
| `lasts` | no | `"once" \| "standing"` | How long a yes keeps working: `once` for this action alone, `standing` for a grant that holds until it is taken back, such as a folder an agent may keep working in. The card says which. |
| `preview` | no | object | What the approver sees. Omit only when the action speaks for itself. |
| `preview.format` | yes | `"markdown" \| "plain" \| "diff" \| "json" \| "table"` | How to render the body. |
| `preview.body` | yes | `string` | The rendered preview. |
| `preview.title` | no | `string` | A heading for the card. |
| `risk` | yes | enum[] | Risk classes. The policy engine matches rules against these. One of `external`, `external_communication`, `irreversible`, `destructive`, `financial`, `credential`, `privacy`, `legal`. |
| `sources` | no | object[] | Where the harness got what it is about to act on. |
| `sources[].kind` | yes | `"external" \| "internal"` | Whether the source is outside the workspace. |
| `sources[].label` | yes | `string` | What to show in the receipt, for example `vendor website`. |
| `sources[].url` | no | `string` | Where to look, when there is somewhere to look. |
| `expires_in` | yes | `number` | Seconds until the approval expires. Every approval has an expiry and a fallback. |
| `fallback` | no | `"deny" \| "allow"` | What happens on expiry. Denying is the default, and the safe one. |
| `approvers` | no | `string[]` | Who may answer, as the harness asks it: `owner`, `any` (the room, but its guests), `role:<name>` (a standing in the space or in the workspace), or a person id. `lead` (the lane's lead, when the run is a lane's) is a policy rule's to name, never a harness's, and never for an ask that matters — money, a deletion, an external action reach a person. Chips resolves them — policy's own list when a rule names one — to ids before the event is stored, and only those may decide it; a person may hand it on with `approval.routed`. |
| `editable` | no | `boolean` | Whether the approver may change the input before allowing. |
| `resume_token` | no | `string` | Lets a paused command-line run continue hours later. Approvals outlive processes. |

## Example

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "type": "approval.request",
  "id": "evt_01K4ZQPX000000000000000068",
  "ts": "2026-09-02T14:22:04.004Z",
  "workspace_id": "ws_01K4ZQPX000000000000000001",
  "space_id": "spc_01K4ZQPX000000000000000002",
  "actor": {
    "kind": "harness",
    "id": "hrn_01K4ZQPX000000000000000004"
  },
  "run_id": "run_01K4ZQPX000000000000000005",
  "approval_id": "apr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000006",
  "step_id": "email-dana",
  "action": {
    "kind": "email.send",
    "input": {
      "to": "dana@northwind.com",
      "subject": "PO #4471 confirmation"
    },
    "external": true,
    "irreversible": true
  },
  "question": "Send this email to dana@northwind.com?",
  "effect": "It confirms PO #4471 for 120 units, delivered 19 September.",
  "lasts": "once",
  "preview": {
    "format": "markdown",
    "title": "To dana@northwind.com",
    "body": "Hi Dana, confirming PO #4471 for 120 units, delivery 19 September. Shout if anything looks off."
  },
  "risk": ["external_communication", "irreversible"],
  "sources": [
    {
      "kind": "external",
      "label": "vendor website",
      "url": "https://northwind.example/contact"
    }
  ],
  "expires_in": 3600,
  "fallback": "deny",
  "approvers": ["usr_01K4ZQPX000000000000000003"],
  "editable": true,
  "resume_token": "rt_9f2c7d0184a05c3b"
}
```
